note: Built 2026-08-19 for ticket #750 (design plugin's first eval suite for this skill; intent.md's original 'fence reciprocity N/A' note is stale as of this build — design-plugin siblings and screens:make-component now carry their own evals.json suites, so reciprocal no-trigger cases were added there in the same change rather than recorded N/A). Positives: 5 verbatim trigger phrasings (t01-t05) + 1 JSON-paste resume trigger (t06) + 4 near-miss paraphrases of the same trigger family (t07-t10) + 1 combined resume+terminate-on-pick case (t11). Negatives fence the built-in design canvas skill and artifact-design (both global, outside this repo — no reciprocal evals.json exists for either), the design-system-checker and screens:component-checker agents (neither carries an evals.json — agents aren't routed by trigger-description eval suites in this estate), screens:make-component (a skill with its own evals.json — reciprocal negative added there), and one adjacent design-plugin skill (pick-fonts) as a sibling-neighborhood check. n11 fences the broadest verbatim trigger ('iterate on this design') against single-design refinement, which reads as canvas/artifact-design territory, not variant generation (skill-checker finding, 2026-08-19). Baseline note: documented-delta form (evals/baseline.md) — the behavior delta is a feedback CONTRACT (structured axis-labeled variants + vote/note widgets + a resumable JSON schema) that cannot exist without the skill, so a no-skill baseline trivially lacks it; live fresh-session captures deferred, same accepted form the original intent.md recorded.
